### 4 Faithful Lessons We Can Learn from Paul and Silas in Prison
Author: Melinda Eye Cooper
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/faithful-lessons-we-can-learn-from-paul-and-silas-in-prison.html
Passage: Acts 16:25-34
Points:
- Praising God during hardship demonstrates genuine faith and captures the attention of onlookers.
- Authentic worship in trials invites the power of God to loosen spiritual and physical chains.
- Choosing restraint instead of self-preservation can safeguard others and create ministry opportunities.
- Remaining steadfast under trial sets a compelling example that can lead entire households to Christ.
